description: Create diagnostic daemon for wisdom_synthesiser which is stale at 10h3m (status=stale, threshold=14400s). File is NOT in PROTECTED_FILES list so a diagnostic is appropriate. Must: (1) query service_health for last heartbeat of wisdom_synthesiser; (2) attempt a lightweight query via write_service to test if daemon is responsive; (3) log findings with severity; (4) propose a restart via supervisord if daemon is non-responsive and >12h stale; (5) do NOT rebuild the daemon itself — only diagnose. Must emit heartbeat to service_health. Pattern: check heartbeat → test responsiveness → log diagnosis → suggest restart.
